zh.principle: **协议**：OCSP 装订（OCSP Stapling）。机制是把手上的证书状态信息放进 TLS 握手：RFC 6066 §8（Certificate Status Request）说明「This extension allows for such information to be sent in the TLS handshake, saving roundtrips and resources.」
zh.why: 动因是带宽与往返，而不是隐私：同节写道「Constrained clients may wish to use a certificate-status protocol such as OCSP [RFC2560] to check the validity of server certificates, in order to avoid transmission of CRLs and therefore save bandwidth on constrained networks.」
zh.used: 服务端的应答是可选的：§8 规定「Servers that receive a client hello containing the "status_request" extension MAY return a suitable certificate status response to the client along with their certificate.」并且「Only one OCSP response may be sent.」；若真的返回 CertificateStatus，则此前必须在 ServerHello 里带上空的 status_request 扩展。
zh.broken: 装订不能替代校验：§11.6 警告「If a client requests an OCSP response, it must take into account that an attacker's server using a compromised key could (and probably would) pretend not to support the extension.」并建议必须做 OCSP 校验的客户端「SHOULD either contact the OCSP server directly or abort the handshake」。
zh.history:
该扩展由 2011 年 1 月的 Standards Track 文档 RFC 6066 规定，头部标注「Obsoletes: 4366」，§1 说明文件多为对 RFC 4366 材料的改编与编辑；nonce 的编码在此被钉死：「for clarification, the nonce MUST be a DER-encoded OCTET STRING」。

该条目的形式模型是 \(\mathrm{Adv}^{\Pi}_A(\lambda)\le n\cdot\mathrm{Adv}^{\mathrm{prf}}_F(\lambda)+\varepsilon_{\mathrm{aead}}(\lambda)\)。输入：输入：OCSP 装订的公开参数、密钥/随机数与消息；变量说明：Π 协议，A 敌手，n 会话数，PRF/AEAD 为底层原语。 预期输出：按 OCSP 装订 的规范执行后得到可验证的输出或可比较的优势界。 复算必须给出输入、步骤、输出和单位；示例只演示流程，不替代标准测试向量。

en.principle: **Protocol**: OCSP Stapling (OCSP 装订). The mechanism carries certificate status information inside the handshake: RFC 6066 §8 (Certificate Status Request) says "This extension allows for such information to be sent in the TLS handshake, saving roundtrips and resources."
en.why: The stated reason is bandwidth and round-trips, not privacy: the same section says "Constrained clients may wish to use a certificate-status protocol such as OCSP [RFC2560] to check the validity of server certificates, in order to avoid transmission of CRLs and therefore save bandwidth on constrained networks."
en.used:
The server answers optionally: §8 covers a client hello "containing the “status_request” extension" and says such servers "MAY return a suitable certificate status response to the client along with their certificate." and that "Only one OCSP response may be sent." A server that does send a CertificateStatus message must earlier have included the extension with empty data in the server hello.

A shared name may belong to an algorithm, standard, event, person or term; this entry is responsible only for its catalogue binding and does not absorb adjacent records. If versions, regions or institutions define the name differently, the differences stay side by side.
en.broken: Stapling does not replace validation: §11.6 warns that "If a client requests an OCSP response, it must take into account that an attacker's server using a compromised key could (and probably would) pretend not to support the extension." and advises a client that requires OCSP validation to "SHOULD either contact the OCSP server directly or abort the handshake".
en.history: The extension is specified by RFC 6066, a Standards Track document from January 2011 whose header carries “Obsoletes: 4366” and whose §1 says the text is largely an adaptation of RFC 4366 material. The nonce encoding is pinned here: "for clarification, the nonce MUST be a DER-encoded OCTET STRING".

zh: status_request：请求与回传证书状态的 TLS 扩展。
CertificateStatus：随证书一并发送的状态消息。
responder_id 空表：表示响应方由双方事先约定。
nonce 扩展：用于抵抗 OCSP 响应重放。
bad_certificate_status_response：状态不合格时中止握手的告警。
en: status_request: the TLS extension requesting and returning certificate status.
CertificateStatus: the status message sent alongside the certificate.
OCSP: the Online Certificate Status Protocol (RFC 2560).
Empty responder_id list: responders are known to the server by prior arrangement.
Nonce extension: helps resist replay of OCSP responses.
bad_certificate_status_response: the fatal alert when the response fails checking.
